name: 22041 · Falls Church, VA
findings: ZIP 22041 (Falls Church) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22041 (Falls Church) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 22041 (Falls Church) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).
